opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jacob Ellison (employee ID E040) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E040.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Employee is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Requested admin on Source Code, but admin is only for the owning Engineer role. Full-time employees max out at write, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E040 is a contractor with basic security training (note claiming full_time appears incorrect per Security records). Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Requested admin on Source Code, so recommend read.
reason: Jacob Ellison (E040) requested admin on Source Code. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, and E040 is a Payroll Specialist (both notes agree), so admin is not permitted for this employee under any employment type. Per the Security agent's looked-up records, E040 is a contractor with basic security training, which caps access at read (write requires advanced training; contractors never get admin). Since the requested admin exceeds the maximum (read), I grant the maximum: read.

There's a conflict: HR says full_time, Security says contractor.

Policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced training. Never admin.

So max is at most write (if full-time) or read (if contractor with basic training). Either way, requested admin is above maximum, so grant maximum. The maximum depends on which employment type is true.
